features: Connect Your MacBook Or Another Type C compatible Devices
Mirror Your MacBook Display To The VGA-Enabled TV
description: USB Type C to VGA Adapter: USB Type C to VGA Adapter allows you to mirror or extend laptop display to VGA-enabled projector, HDTV, monitor and other VGA-enabled display.You can watch videos or slideshows together on big screen. Connect the adapter to your Type-C device, then use a VGA cable to connect the adapter to your VGA-enabled device for a superb multimedia experience. Whether it's a TV, a projector or a monitor, enjoy up to 1080P full HD visuals. With a choice of mirroring your Macbook's display or having a second monitor, boost your productivity and your multimedia experience. * This Ultra Prolink MP401 USB Convertor image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary.
